description: This file defines the MenuLinkInterface interface for Drupal, specifying methods for menu link properties and operations.

classes.name: MenuLinkInterface
classes.description: Defines an interface for classes providing a type of menu link.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight of the menu link.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the localized title to be shown for this link.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the menu link.

methods.name: getMenuName
methods.description: Returns the menu name of the menu link.

methods.name: getProvider
methods.description: Returns the provider (module name) of the menu link.

methods.name: getParent
methods.description: Returns the plugin ID of the menu link's parent.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether the menu link is enabled (not hidden).

methods.name: isExpanded
methods.description: Returns whether the child menu links should always be shown.

methods.name: isResettable
methods.description: Returns whether this link can be reset.

methods.name: isTranslatable
methods.description: Returns whether this link can be translated.

methods.name: isDeletable
methods.description: Returns whether this link can be deleted.

methods.name: getRouteName
methods.description: Returns the route name, if available.

methods.name: getRouteParameters
methods.description: Returns the route parameters, if available.

methods.name: getUrlObject
methods.description: Returns a URL object containing either the external path or route.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Returns the options for this link.

methods.name: getMetaData
methods.description: Returns any metadata for this link.

methods.name: updateLink
methods.description: Updates the definition values for a menu link.

methods.name: deleteLink
methods.description: Deletes a menu link.

methods.name: getFormClass
methods.description: Returns the class name for building an editing form for this link.

methods.name: getDeleteRoute
methods.description: Returns route info for deleting the menu link.

methods.name: getEditRoute
methods.description: Returns route info for a custom edit form.

methods.name: getResetRoute
methods.description: Returns route info for resetting the menu link.

methods.name: getTranslateRoute
methods.description: Returns route info for translating the menu link.

methods.name: getOperations
methods.description: Provides info to build a list of operation links.
